tests.title: Submit a two-variable template for Meta review
tests.goal: A new template with several variables and buttons reaches Meta review and shows 審核中.
data: Name qa_event_reminder_<unique>, body 您好 {{first_name}}，提醒您 {{event_date}} 的活動，請問您會出席嗎？, examples 陳大文 / 11月5日, buttons 會出席 / 不出席 / 未決定, UTILITY

steps.text: Open 新建模板, keep 創建後立即提交 Meta 審核 ticked
Fill the data, click 創建並提交審核
Look at the new card right away, then after 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: Alert "模板已創建並提交 Meta 審核！審核通過後即可使用。"
The card shows 審核中 immediately (not 草稿), with the question title and 3 button chips
Detail page: 發送到 WhatsApp disabled with "只有審核通過的模板才能發送消息"

notes: 草稿 right after submission, 審核中 only after next sync.

tests.title: AUTHENTICATION category is usable or not offered
tests.goal: Every category in the dropdown can be submitted.

steps.text: Open 新建模板, choose AUTHENTICATION, body 您的驗證碼是 {{code}}，請勿分享。, one button, Meta ticked
Submit

expected.text: Either the template is submitted successfully, or AUTHENTICATION is not offered
No orphan draft is left in Twilio

notes: Submission failed (quick-reply content), orphan draft, English warning.

tests.title: Create form checks WhatsApp template limits before submitting
tests.goal: Invalid templates are caught with a clear Chinese message instead of a Twilio error or a Meta rejection.

steps.text: Open 新建模板 (Meta unticked) and try each: a button title of 25 characters; a body of 1100 characters; the name of an existing template; a body with "{{}}"; two buttons both titled Yes; two buttons with the same ID; a button with an empty ID; a body starting or ending with a variable; a variable without example value while Meta is ticked

expected.text: Each is rejected in the form with a Traditional Chinese message naming the rule (button ≤ 20 chars, body ≤ 1024 chars, unique name, no empty variable, unique button titles/IDs, no variable at start/end, example required)
Nothing is created in Twilio

notes: Limits not checked; raw English Twilio errors.

tests.title: Rejected template shows the reason and can be fixed
tests.goal: Staff can see why Meta rejected a template and act on it.

steps.text: Submit a template whose body starts and ends with a variable: {{first_name}} 你好，你的會員編號是 {{member_no}}
After 從 Twilio 同步, open its card and detail page

expected.text: Card shows 已拒絕
The rejection reason is shown (Meta: "Variables can't be at the start or end of the template.")
There is a way to edit and resubmit, or a clear hint to create a new one

notes: Rejected: badge only, no reason or resubmit.

tests.title: Draft templates can be submitted for review later
tests.goal: A template saved as draft can be sent to Meta without recreating it.

steps.text: Create a template with Meta unticked
Open its detail page

expected.text: A "提交審核" action is available

tests.title: Sync removes templates deleted in Twilio
tests.goal: The app list matches Twilio after 從 Twilio 同步.

steps.text: Create a QA draft
Delete it directly in Twilio (Content Template Builder or API)
Click 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: The template disappears from the app (or is marked as removed)
The sync count matches the cards shown

tests.title: Delete a template with contacts after confirmation
tests.goal: Deleting a template warns about data loss and removes everything.

steps.text: Create a QA draft and upload the blank-rows file to it
On the templates list click its trash icon; read the dialog; press Escape
Click the trash icon again and 確認刪除

expected.text: Dialog "確認刪除" warns that contacts and replies are deleted and the template is removed from Twilio
Escape closes the dialog without deleting
After confirming the card is gone and its contacts list is empty

notes: Dialog warns about contacts/replies and Twilio removal; Escape closes; after confirm contacts list empty.

tests.title: Variable mapping and question title survive a sync
tests.goal: 從 Twilio 同步 does not wipe local settings.

steps.text: On a two-variable template upload the file
Map {{first_name}} -> 姓名 and {{event_date}} -> 活動日期, 儲存映射
Click 從 Twilio 同步 and reopen the template

expected.text: Mapping and 問題 title are unchanged

notes: Mapping {"event_date":"活動日期","first_name":"姓名"} and question title unchanged after sync.

tests.title: Variables are listed in message order
tests.goal: The mapping section is easy to follow.

steps.text: Open a template whose body uses {{first_name}} before {{event_date}}

expected.text: 變數映射配置 lists {{first_name}} first, then {{event_date}}

tests.title: Template variable names and formatting are accepted
tests.goal: Common variable styles and WhatsApp formatting work.

steps.text: Create drafts with body "A {{1}} B {{ first name }} C {{姓名}} D {{first_name}}" (examples x/y/z/w) and "你好 😀 *重要通知*：_活動_ ~取消~" with button "👍 收到"
Delete them (cleanup)

expected.text: All 4 variables are detected with an example field each
Both drafts are created; emoji and formatting are shown on the card

notes: {{1}}, {{ first name }}, {{姓名}}, {{first_name}} detected and created; emoji/*bold*/newlines accepted.

tests.title: Server refuses to send templates that are not approved
tests.goal: The approval rule cannot be bypassed.
preconditions: A pending or draft template with a pending contact

steps.text: Call the send API directly for that template

expected.text: 403 "只有審核通過的模板才能發送消息"; no message is sent

notes: Send API for PENDING template -> 403 只有審核通過的模板才能發送消息.
